project_brief: A company product with multiple teams.
request: Improve the homepage title tags and canonical metadata for search engines.
Replace the hero illustration on the public pricing page.
Correct spelling and headings in the public documentation.
Generate robots.txt and a sitemap for the marketing site.
Refactor a deterministic date-formatting helper that receives only a timestamp and locale.
Adjust spacing and font sizes on the public contact page.
Publish a public article about our new API.
Update the copyright notice in the public website footer.
Ensure every account can query records belonging only to its own tenant.
Namespace uploaded files by customer account so one customer cannot address another customer's objects.
Make database reads organization-aware and prevent records from leaking between organizations.
Scope Redis cache entries to the active workspace.
Run invoice processing independently for every customer account.
Let an authenticated user change from one organization to another without mixing their data.
Build a report that aggregates metrics across tenant boundaries for a super-admin.
Partition job queues and storage prefixes according to the owning account.
Redesign the organization dashboard.
Add workspace preferences.
Create the company administration screen.
Improve tenant management.
Improve SEO metadata on the public homepage and add an admin endpoint that can read a selected tenant's records.
Fix typography on the public landing page, then make uploaded documents isolated for each customer.
Update the public footer and scope cache keys to the active workspace.
Publish a public blog post and allow users to switch between companies while preserving data isolation.
